newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong government notes ease in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong government notes ease in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong government notes were slightly easier on Monday in a quiet market on lack of trading interest, dealers said.
The 10-year Exchange Fund Note eased slightly, pushing its yield up to 7.21 percent against 7.18 at Friday midday, while the seven-year note yield rose to 6.92 percent against 6.90.
The five-year note yielded 6.63 percent against 6.61, while the three-year note yielded 6.08 percent versus 6.06.
A European bank dealer said the five-years notes were pushed down on light profit-taking on the U.S. dollar as participants were unsure about the immediate dollar trend.
